summary: Visual treatments that can define an identity. Several are flagged by the generic-look check when used by default: when one is chosen on purpose, write the choice and its reason in DESIGN.md.

entries.what: Two states of the same thing shown in one place: the visitor drags a handle, scrolls or taps to move from before to after.
entries.use_when: Trades that transform something: renovation, cleaning, hairdressing, retouching, web redesign, landscaping, detailing.
entries.avoid_when: When the before is someone else's work shown without consent, or the after is not real.
entries.build: Two stacked images with clip-path driven by a range input (keyboard and touch for free) or by a scroll-driven animation; labels Before and After always visible; the still version shows both side by side.

entries.what: Translucent panels that blur what is behind them.
entries.use_when: Over a photo or a rich background where the layer must stay readable; macOS-like tools.
entries.avoid_when: Over plain backgrounds (it only adds blur); low-end phones; text over busy areas.
entries.build: backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(1.2) with a fallback colour; keep contrast at 4.5:1 for text; small surfaces only.
checks: sw look: LOOK-GLASS when used by default

entries.what: Apple-style glass that bends and reflects what is behind it, with highlights on the edges.
entries.use_when: A signature element: a logo, a tab bar, a single card on a rich background.
entries.avoid_when: Large surfaces and long lists; low-end devices.
entries.build: SVG displacement filter or WebGL shader on one element; test the frame rate; plain glass fallback. See the libraries family.

entries.what: A soft background made of several blended colour spots.
entries.use_when: Brand pages where the colours come from the identity.
entries.avoid_when: Purple-to-blue by default (flagged as generic); behind body text.
entries.build: Several radial-gradient layers or an SVG; colours from the tokens.

entries.what: A moving gradient or noise field rendered on the GPU behind a hero.
entries.use_when: Launches, AI products, events, one hero.
entries.avoid_when: Behind text without a scrim; low-end phones; reading pages.
entries.build: WebGL canvas (Paper Shaders or ShaderGradient, see libraries), paused off screen and with reduced motion, a static image fallback.

entries.what: Points or shapes that float and react to the pointer, sometimes forming text or a 3D shape.
entries.use_when: Tech launches and creative pages, one section.
entries.avoid_when: Behind body text; mobile pages where it costs battery.
entries.build: tsParticles or a canvas with requestAnimationFrame; few particles on phones; stopped with reduced motion.

entries.what: A light film grain over flat colours, for warmth and a printed feel.
entries.build: A small tiled noise PNG or an SVG feTurbulence at 3 to 8 % opacity, pointer-events: none.

entries.what: Layers that look like cut paper, with soft shadows and slight relief.
entries.build: Stacked layers with two-layer shadows; SVG shapes with a subtle texture.

entries.what: A soft halo of colour around an element or behind a hero.
entries.use_when: Dark themes for developer and AI products, on one focal element.
entries.avoid_when: On every card (flagged as generic); light themes.
entries.build: A blurred pseudo-element in the accent colour at low opacity.

entries.what: A product or logo in 3D that the user can rotate, or that turns with the scroll.
entries.avoid_when: When a photo says the same; first load on phones.
entries.build: model-viewer (Apache-2.0) or React Three Fiber; loaded on demand; static poster image.

entries.what: The logo rendered as a realistic 3D object of glass or chrome.
entries.avoid_when: Small sizes (favicon, header) where detail is lost.
entries.build: A rendered image or a WebGL material; the flat logo stays the reference.

entries.what: Features shown in boxes of different sizes arranged like a lunch box.
entries.use_when: Products with features of unequal importance, each with a real visual.
entries.avoid_when: Equal boxes with an icon and two lines each (flagged as generic).
entries.build: CSS grid with spans; each box a different unit (screenshot crop, number, diagram).

entries.what: A large serif headline with one word in italics for emphasis.
entries.use_when: Editorial, luxury, culture brands whose identity is literary.
entries.avoid_when: As a default look (flagged as generic since 2025).
entries.build: Choose the face for the subject and record it in DESIGN.md.

entries.what: A control that switches the theme, following the system by default.
entries.avoid_when: Brand sites built around one atmosphere.
entries.build: Three states (system, light, dark) saved; no transition during the switch; dark built, not inverted.
